runtime.all_numbers_below: Complexity/storage estimates only; no production timing measured and no strategy data read.
runtime.naive_support_work_estimate: About 226.8 million point-portfolio score evaluations for five CE modes x two fees x 120 scenarios x 30 years x 2700 training points, counting target and keep alternatives; not a runtime measurement.
runtime.cached_work_estimate: Precache five target inverse-cube moments across four folds (54000 training target-dot evaluations); remaining keep scoring approximately 97.2 million training-point dots plus small prefix work. Reuse only if folds/distributions are identical; fee affects wealth/state but not prior support.
runtime.memory_estimate: Four raw prior arrays of shape2700x3 float64 occupy259200 bytes excluding container overhead; retaining diagnostics/all Python objects and serialized text dominates. Stream by mode/scenario as needed.
risks: Pure Python inner support loops or rebuilding all prior support per review can dominate; vectorize using existing NumPy only if installed project environment supports it. Measure bounded synthetic smoke first.
